entries.title: Purpose

entries.title: Product Overview
entries.summary: Clari5 is a real-time, AI-augmented AML and fraud-management platform used by banks and financial institutions globally. The Sanctions Screening module enables compliance teams to screen individuals, entities, and payment parties against one or more international and domestic watchlists, review match results, and take structured disposition actions — all within a single workflow.

bullets.text: This document covers the following capabilities of the Sanctions Screening module: Landing page — Match Results dashboard Manual Screening (Single / File-based) — initiating a new screening request Screening Results page — displaying matches returned for a given screening query Match Review — three-tab review workspace: AI Summary tab (GenAI-powered narrative and risk signal cards) Match Details tab (per-hit attribute comparison tables) View Summary tab (aggregate scorecard and weighted attribute table) Disposition actions: Confirm Match, False Positive, Move to Case, Move to Whitelist, Move to Exception List Sidebar navigation across all Sanctions Screening sub-modules The following are out of scope for this FSD: Batch Screening, De-dup Screening, Real-time Monitoring, Payments Workflow, watchlist administration, and system-administration settings
